# DesktopWindow

## Purpose
Turns the player window into a small borderless, always-on-top strip docked above the Windows taskbar, and moves it when dragged.

## Concepts
desktop window, taskbar, borderless, always on top, dock, drag window, user32, IDesktopWindowService
